summary.en: The Atlanta Hawks rallied from 13 points down to beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 at home in the NBA. Detroit led by 11 entering the fourth quarter, but Atlanta opened the period with an 18-0 run and outscored the visitors 33-12 in the final frame. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points including six three-pointers, Lu Dort added 10 of his 16 points in the fourth quarter, and reserve Corey Kispert chipped in a season-high 18. Pistons star Cade Cunningham was held to a season-low five points. The Hawks win their fourth straight and move up to third in the Eastern Conference.

summary.en: Le Mans staged a stunning second-half comeback to beat Marseille 3-2 away in Ligue 1 Matchday 11. summary.en: AC Milan returned to the Serie A top four with a 5-1 thrashing of Frosinone at San Siro, moving to within five points of leaders Lazio. Milan led 2-0 inside 19 minutes through a Gabriele Calvani own goal and a Goncalo Ramos strike, before Patrizio Masini pulled one back in the 25th minute. Substitutes Ardon Jashari and Alphadjo Cisse scored after the break, and Christian Pulisic completed the rout in the 68th minute. summary.en: Liverpool thrashed Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield in the Premier League, handing new United manager Mauricio Pochettino a nightmare debut. United were reduced to ten men after just eight minutes when Leny Yoro brought down Alexander Isak following a Matthijs de Ligt error, and Liverpool struck twice in quick succession — Dominik Szoboszlai curling in the resulting free kick in the 10th minute before Florian Wirtz volleyed home Rio Ngumoha's cross in the 13th. Ngumoha added a third in the 66th minute, becoming the youngest scorer against United in a league match, and substitute Victor Munoz completed the rout in the 82nd minute. Liverpool dominated with 64% possession and 28 shots, climbing to fourth, one point behind Brighton and Manchester City, while United dropped to 19th, one point from safety.

summary.en: The Washington Wizards routed the Orlando Magic 116-96 at home, racing to a 38-21 first-quarter lead and never trailing, at one point ahead by 25 points. Washington hit 22 three-pointers on 39 attempts, one short of the franchise record, with seven players in double figures; KyShawn George scored 24 points including six threes and Anthony Davis added 22 points and seven rebounds. Tristan da Silva led Orlando with 18 points; the Wizards won a third straight game for the first time this season to improve to 8-11, while the Magic fell to 7-10.

summary.en: The Dallas Mavericks edged the Utah Jazz 116-114 on the road, leading 91-74 after three quarters before Utah's 40-25 fourth-quarter comeback tied the game at 114-114. Cooper Flagg led Dallas with 28 points, making nine of 10 free throws, while Kyrie Irving added 16 points and eight assists; Svi Mykhailiuk scored 39 points for Utah, including 23 in the fourth quarter. Dallas improved to 10-7, while Utah fell to 3-15.

summary.en: The Miami Heat beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 at home for a seventh straight win, improving to 10-6 after leading wire to wire and by as many as 20 points. Bam Adebayo recorded 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists for the ninth regular-season triple-double of his career, while Pelle Larsson added 21 points and seven Heat players scored in double figures. Both teams were without their MVPs: the Thunder's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was out with neck and back injuries, and Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo missed the game with a groin strain.

Marco Friedl broke the deadlock in the 55th minute, Justin Njinmah scored twice in the 66th and 70th minutes on his first start since the end of August and was named man of the match, and Niclas Füllkrug sealed the win with a stoppage-time strike, his 10th league goal of the season.
